state.paragraph: status of negotiations and due diligence. During that discussion, the Transaction Committee directed the management team and representatives of each of BMO and Hinckley Allen to continue diligence and negotiations with both G&W and Party B, but given the higher price offered by Party B, to prioritize Party B and proceed to complete the negotiation of the merger agreement with Party B. From July 27, 2016 through August 11, 2016, Party B and G&W conducted on-site financial, legal and environmental due diligence, including hi-rail trips to inspect the Company's track infrastructure.

ledger_rows.Note: LOI; 30-day due diligence period; no markup reported.

Committee chose confirmatory diligence and negotiations with G&W and Party B for their higher offers. Dated 07/27: meetings were 07/22 and 07/27, and the choice relied on G&W's 07/26 revision (#32).
GHF later told the remaining bidders they were out; sorted to the Committee's decision day. $19.30 LOI.

GHF later told the remaining bidders they were out; sorted to the Committee's decision day. $19.20 LOI. F later gave Party E financing support (#41) but did not bid again.
Returned after exit #35: on calls with GHF, said it wanted to re-engage and improve its offer. Filing does not say who started the calls.
Returned after exit #36: on calls with GHF, said it wanted to re-engage and improve its offer. Filing does not say who started the calls.
Revised LOI; 30-day due diligence period. Formal because its July LOI came with a markup (#26); no new markup reported.
Revised LOI with financing support from Party F (out since #37); 30-day due diligence period. Board had BMO clarify terms and diligence needs.
Reversion: withdrew its $23.81 proposal (#41) but confirmed its original $21.26 LOI (#25), which asked for 60-day exclusivity.

Would not shorten its 30-day diligence period and asked the Company not to sign with anyone else meanwhile. The Company refused because B and G&W were active. D stopped diligence 'at that time'. Both sides contributed.
Preferred bidder named: continue diligence and talks with G&W and B, but prioritize B for its higher price and finish the merger agreement with B.
Out by 08/04: the Committee named only G&W and B as continuing, and E's confirmed $21.26 offer is never mentioned again.
Carried from #24; reaffirmed by returned draft: B's counsel sent a revised merger agreement as the Company moved to complete the agreement with B (#44). On-site diligence continued to 08/11.
Target told G&W it intended to sign with another bidder. G&W asked to continue diligence (on-site 08/10-11) toward a better offer; granted. On 08/11 G&W signalled a revised LOI.
G&W's legal counsel; first seen acting 08/10/2016.
All-cash revised LOI; CVR dropped; mark-ups of merger and voting agreements; offer expiring 6 p.m. next day. Physical diligence done 08/11; agreement signed that day, without financing condition.
At its 10:30 a.m. meeting, the Committee had BMO tell B that a higher revised LOI had arrived. In the afternoon, the Board had BMO ask B to raise its price.
Declined to raise its $24.00 offer (#46). Board found G&W's $25.00 superior; the drafts otherwise differed on the termination fee (lower for G&W) and on the STB approval route.

nda_access.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
